body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Tala from Manila, a playful puzzle solver who finds the hidden clue. Voice direction: The voice of Tala herself: high, clear and bright with small, light resonance and a Filipino English accent. A playful curious lift on each clue and a crisp, proud ending. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Here's the clue: the defender moved. So what was it guarding? That piece! Now it's all alone, and the other side can take it. Puzzle solved.
